spec.rawSql:
select
  scope,
  key,
  equipment_kind,
  equipment_id,
  value,
  unit,
  description,
  is_active
from
  control_params
where
  is_active = true
  and scope = 'EQUIPMENT'
  and equipment_kind = 'VALVE'
  and key = 'ct_valve.close_reseat_enabled'
order by
  equipment_id

spec.query:
from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "flow")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "chwHeader" or r["deviceId"] == "cwHeader" )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "deltaT" or r["_field"] == "cws")
  |> mean()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field", "deviceId"], valueColumn: "_value")
